'''August 2000 Sherwood tournament (25 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sherwood, Arkansas on 25 August 2000. It is known from Jared Beavers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1161">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-26-sherwood-arkanas-8-25-00d1161/ sherwood-arkanas-8-25-00], DeckTech (Jared "Romas" Beavers, 26 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-26-sherwood-arkanas-8-25-00d1161/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Sherwood, Arkansas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
